title.narrative: Integrated lifesaving response to peak lean season WASH and protection needs in Konduga and Mafa local government areas of Borno state.

description.narrative: ltpgtltbgtSimari, Zanari, Kaleri, Flatari and Musakaleri Communities in Konduga and Mafa LGAs of Borno State lt/bgtface persistent threats to life due to prolonged conflict, displacement, recurring natural disasters and the erosion of basic services. Vulnerable groups, especially, women, adolescent girls, and internally displaced persons (IDPs) continue to endure limited access to safe water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH) facilities, while simultaneously being exposed to increased risks of gender-based violence (GBV) and exploitation,ltbrgtWithout urgent interventions, the compounded effects of poor WASH conditions, disease outbreaks, malnutrition, and protection risks will continue to undermine health, dignity, and resilience in these crisis-affected communities. Women and girls, tasked with water collection and domestic hygiene, are disproportionately affected, facing heightened exposure to violence and harmful coping mechanisms.ltbrgtThree local actors: Jireh Doo Foundation (JDF), Action Aid Nigeria (AAN) and New Foundation for Displaced Persons (NFDP) have proposed to deliver a six-month response that addresses critical WASH and GBV needs concurrently, in alignment with the 2025 Humanitarian Response Plan (HRP) and the allocation’s strategic objectives of saving lives, restoring dignity, and building resilience while advancing local priorities. JDF as the Consortium lead will implement Hard components of WASH providing technical backstopping and coordination to NFDP implementing WASH-soft component and AAN implementing GBV component.ltbrgtThis integrated WASH and GBV project will directly benefit 15,000 vulnerable individuals (approximately 9000 females and 6000 males), with a strong emphasis on women, children, and persons with disability, in Konduga and Mafa LGAs, reducing risks of disease, malnutrition, and violence while restoring dignity and resilience.ltbrgtSpecifically, the project will: Enhance access to safe and sustainable water supply through the rehabilitation of 8 non-functional water facilities (4 solar boreholes and 4 handpumps and sustained operation and maintenance. Improve sanitation coverage to reduce open defecation by constructing and or rehabilitating fire-damaged 18 blocks of communal and household sanitation facilities, desludging provision of handwashing facilities and latrine cleaning items. Prevent and or respond to outbreaks of cholera and other diarrheal diseases through strengthened hygiene knowledge and practices using community human resources completed by the provision of basic hygiene items including soap to support handwashing at critical times. Case Area Target Intervention CATI) will be activated to ensure timely response with the first 48 hours of, reported suspected or confirmed case of the Acute Watery Diarrhea (AWD)/Cholera collaborating closely with health Sector. Reduce protection risks faced by women and adolescent girls by operating safe spaces, facilitating community awareness on (GBV, prevention, and integration of culturally sensitive dialogues to challenge harmful gender stereotypes and expand access to GBV response services by establishing and strengthening community-based reporting mechanisms, training community focal points and project staff, carrying out psychosocial services and linking survivors to legal support services in coordination with other protection partners.ltbrgtIn collaboration with government agencies, community leaders, the humanitarian community, we commit to jointly delivering this integrated response. Together, we will leverage expertise, resources, and accountability to ensure lifesaving, inclusive, and dignified services reach the most vulnerable communities. Our collective action will strengthen local leadership, foster resilience, and uphold the rights and dignity of affected populations in Borno State.ltbrgtBy combining life-saving WASH services with protection interventions, the project addresses both the immediate humanitarian needs and the underlying vulnerabilities.lt/pgt
